scope: MSM8226 SLIMbus NGD read after the QMI power vote (diagnostics/slimbus-ngd-probe) on the installed r8 kernel, owner present

interpretation.qmi: ADSP SLIMbus QMI service 0x301 at node 5 port 3; select-instance (master mode) and power active/inactive all succeeded
interpretation.version: control word 0x01010000: version 0x0101 (non-zero, so the vendor driver uses its V2 NGD layout)
interpretation.ngd_offset: vendor NGD_BASE_V2 for cell-index 1 = 0x1000, the same as mainline qcom-ngd-ctrl v1.5.0 (id 1 x offset 0x1000); the 0x804 read is the unused V1 location
interpretation.ngd_status: 0x0000040c at 0x1004: NGD_LADDR (bit 1) clear, so no logical address yet (expected before enumeration); vendor message-queue pipe index (status & 0xfc) >> 2 = 3
interpretation.dmas: apps RX message queue = BAM pipe 3, TX = pipe 4 (vendor init_tx_msgq adds 1): dmas = <&slimbam 3>, <&slimbam 4>, dma-names = "rx", "tx"

safety: no hang; ADSP stayed running; probe unloaded; kernel tainted only by the unsigned out-of-tree modules (cleared on reboot)
